title: Add a persistent navigation bar to apps/architecture-studio so the owner can navigate between the three surfaces (Explorer, VTT Generation, Agents) instead of typing URLs
objective: Owner-directed: 'preciso que voce refatore a pagina do architecture-studio para que eu consiga navegar entre as diferentes paginas.' The three surfaces added this session (/ explorer, /vtt-generation, /agents) each render independently with no shared chrome linking them. This task adds a persistent top-level nav bar (in the root layout) with Next.js <Link> navigation and active-route highlighting. While implementing this, found and fixed a related latent layout bug: globals.css applied its 3-row grid (64px topbar / flexible middle / 38px footer) directly to the bare `body` selector, which is now shared across all three routes since layout.tsx is the app's single root layout -- this meant /vtt-generation and /agents were being laid out as a single grid item auto-placed into the first 64px row track, effectively squeezing their content into a 64px-tall band. Fixed by scoping that grid to a new `.explorer-shell` class (only the explorer page uses it) and making `body` a plain flex column (nav + flexible content area) shared by all routes.
validations: DONE: studio-nav.tsx renders Link-based navigation to /, /vtt-generation, /agents with usePathname()-driven aria-current highlighting, mounted once in layout.tsx above {children}; verified via curl that the correct link gets aria-current="page" on each of the three routes.
DONE: globals.css's body-level 3-row grid is scoped to .explorer-shell instead of the bare body selector; body is now a plain flex column shared correctly by all three routes.
DONE: explorer-client.tsx's root fragment wrapped in div.explorer-shell.
DONE: vtt-generation's root container no longer forces height:100vh.
DONE: tsc --noEmit and next build both pass; all 8 pre-existing unit tests still pass; all three routes return HTTP 200; MCP round-trip still works.
DONE: docs-generate re-run for architecture-studio, docs-quality-check clean.
PENDING: owner's own visual confirmation in a real browser (no browser-automation tool available to the agent).
risks: The 64px-squeeze bug on /vtt-generation and /agents was real but I had not visually caught it myself (no browser tool available) -- the owner's own browser check of /vtt-generation and /agents earlier may have already been affected by this; worth a fresh look after this fix.
